heading: Evidence for defence.
text:
The accused shall then be called upon to enter upon his defence and produce his evidence; and the provisions of section 243 shall apply to the case.
C.—Conclusion of trial
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Code of Criminal Procedure 1973, 02 of 1974 (Rep., Act 46 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
